title: A dragon fruit peel-derived heterogeneous catalyst for Michael addition reactions and methanolysis of PET waste: a green and dual-functional approach
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00253B, Paper

Vanlalngaihawma Khiangte, Samson Lalhmangaihzuala, Z. T. Laldinpuii, Khiangte Vanlaldinpuia
In this study, we investigate the innovative use of a low-cost dragon fruit peel-derived heterogeneous catalyst for two environmentally significant reactions: the Michael addition reactions and the methanolysis of PET waste.
